info.name: Dropbox Lite - Download Service
info.description:
Direct-to-service requests for download-service (bypasses the API Gateway). Auth is simulated via the X-User-Id header, matching CurrentUserHeaderFilter which normally trusts a header set by the gateway after JWT validation.

Important: download-service resolves fileId -> MinIO object key via a live call to metadata-service, then streams real bytes from MinIO. The dev-seed test files from metadata-service's DevDataSeeder (Q3-Report.pdf, sunset.jpg, etc.) are metadata-only fixtures with no real MinIO object behind them - downloading one of those will fail with a 502 (DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE), which is actually correct behavior, not a bug. To test a real download, first run the upload-service collection's full flow (Initiate Upload -> Upload Part -> Complete Upload) and use the fileId from the Complete Upload response here.

variable.description: Fixed dev-seed test user UUID (see metadata-service DevDataSeeder)
Set this to a real fileId from a completed upload (see upload-service collection's Complete Upload response).

request.description: Expect 200 OK, full bytes, with Content-Type, Content-Length, Content-Disposition: attachment, and Accept-Ranges: bytes in the response headers.
Expect 206 Partial Content with Content-Range: bytes {{rangeStart}}-{{rangeEnd}}/<totalSize> and Content-Length = (rangeEnd - rangeStart + 1).
"bytes=N-" means from byte N to the end of the file. Expect 206 Partial Content.
"bytes=-N" means the last N bytes of the file. Expect 206 Partial Content.
Start is far beyond any realistic file size, so this range is unsatisfiable. Expect 416 Requested Range Not Satisfiable with Content-Range: bytes */<totalSize>.
A random, non-existent fileId. Expect 404 Not Found (metadata-service reports no such file/owner match).
